items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The name 'Ali' appears only in the interviewer's question ('In what way was strict, Ali?') addressing the interviewee. The interviewee's response discusses Mr. Contrell, showing no personal relationship with anyone named Ali.

ctx.x: No. No, it took your sticks. Just roll. Just roll? Just drop one stick. You see, roll is supposed to start with your left, man. Not your right. You like to jump the pick and roll the start with your right. The left hand. You just drop your stick on the pedal. Boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. And you make it go fast. And speed it up. The first thing you know you're rolling. Yeah. That's the way you should do. Did Mr. Contrell ever play with you or show you with…
You say he was very strict. In what way was he strict, Ali?

Well, I mean if he gave you a lesson you better come and tell him that you don't know that lesson because he's going to show you just how it goes. And he'll show you just how to make it. And if you come to him and you tell him how you can make this, how you make that man, give the sand.
